sayLines.line: Diana is staying at Haven as the camp healer now — tending the sick instead of ranging out.
the woman in her 30s, with a nervous tic came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
★ IDENTIFIED: Neem. Feathery leaves, bitter smell. Medicine, not food — small amounts only. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
🧭 Salvatore is back from the west. "It's... different out there. I'll tell you about it." (Ask them what they saw.)
🎒 Roksolana shoulders a pack. "Going far this time. Don't wait up."
🧭 Roksolana is back from past the north (+1063 kcal for the pantry, 3 stories, a new scar) (Ask them what they saw.)
